info.title: Shadify Universal API
info.description: Generate and validate puzzle data using the open-source Shadify public REST API, including Sudoku, Takuzu, Set, math, Schulte tables, Minesweeper, word search, anagrams, countries quizzes, Camp, Kuromasu, and memory grids.
